item.title: Smart Layer Network: Roadmap for 2025 and Beyond
item.dc:creator: Victor Zhang
item.content:encoded:
As we move towards Q1 close, we wanted to provide a 2025 Roadmap update for our community.

Our strategic focus on the TApps ecosystem for 2025 remains the same. Our goal is to build continuing developer interest in TApps as a new digital primitive that lets tokens function as multi-platform mini apps.

At the same time, we are highly cognizant of market conditions and developer on new forms of asset issuance and trading, especially around memecoins and in AI. That is why, we have been focused in late 2024 and through most of Q1 2025 on strategically developing the infrastructure for asset issuance and trading.

Over the remainder of H1 2025 we will remain focused on AI asset issuance and infrastructure specifically via TheMajor.ai where our underlying Smart Token and TApps technology plays a key role.

In addition to providing much needed utility to the $SLN token, it offers an additional way for us to onboard developers ito our core technology in preparation for Mainnet launch in late 2025.

Late 2024: Building the Foundations of Asset Issuance

In the last quarter of 2024, we made significant progress in developing core infrastructure for digital asset issuance. One of our major accomplishments was the deployment of BangerMeme, a testbed project now live on Base:

https://bangermeme.fun/

This initiative was more than just a test case — it was an important validation of our underlying asset trading and issuance infrastructure. By successfully launching BangerMeme, we demonstrated that SLN’s core technology could support the seamless creation, distribution, and exchange of digital assets.

Through this process, we gathered valuable insights into market demand, builder needs, and optimal deployment strategies. These learnings directly shaped our next phase of development: TheMajor.ai and NFT Agents that Swarm x-chain.

2025: Expanding Asset Issuance with AI Agents

Our next major focus was AI Agents with Swarm capabilities and cross-platform verifiable identities. These agents will play a transformative role in digital ecosystems by

• Collaborating autonomously to complete tasks and execute smart contracts

• Operating across multiple platforms with verifiable, persistent identities

• Interacting seamlessly with decentralized applications (TApps)

We successfully launched TheMajor as an Agent and Agent Coin Launchpad as well as providing The Arena as an environment for Agents to collaborate and swarm. In addition we :

  • partnered with ai16z using their ElizaOS Framework
  • partnered with Project89 on x-chain swarm and community
  • partnered with MOOAR NFT Marketplace and FSL Labs
  • partnered with MintChain NFT L2

TheMajor has been launched as an Agent on Discord, Farcaster and soon X and we are actively collaborating with the above partners on new agent launches and arena games which will unfold later this quarter.

We believe AI-driven agents and digital assets will be a major growth area, and Smart Layer has a clear product differentiation around NFT Agents that will grow in traction as the market recovers in the coming months.

Strengthening the $SLN Economy

Every new type of asset issuance uses $SLN as the base asset, reinforcing its utility and long-term value. By embedding $SLN into all digital economies built on Smart Layer, we are ensuring that it remains at the core of an expanding ecosystem.

Our goal is to create a self-sustaining digital economies, where new asset classes — whether AI Agents, digital goods, or tokenized utilities — drive increased demand for $SLN.

Scaling for the Future

We are aligning our roadmap with where market interest and builder activity are strongest. One of our biggest takeaways from the success of projects like @virtuals_io is that asset issuance is the primary driver of innovation and engagement.

SLN is positioning itself at the forefront of this trend by continuously enhancing our digital asset issuance infrastructure, ensuring that builders can create, launch, and trade new assets seamlessly.

Looking Ahead

2025 is shaping up to be a landmark year for SLN as we transition into full mainnet deployment and expand our TApps ecosystem. Our strategic approach to delivering on this milestone is four-fold :

  • Delivering scalable asset issuance solutions for developers and creators
  • Expanding the adoption of AI-driven digital assets with NFT Agents
  • Strengthening the utility of $SLN through the above
  • Deliver Mainnet in late 2025

Smart Layer Network: Roadmap for 2025 and Beyond was originally published in Smart Token Labs on Medium, where people are continuing the conversation by highlighting and responding to this story.

item.title: Tapps: The Way Forward
item.dc:creator: Luke Toledo
item.content:encoded:
Tapps are the focus for Smart Layer going forward.

This will have a profound impact on the direction of $SLN, and if you are an investor or a developer… you will want to read this.

In this article, I will tell you about:

  • The use case for Tapps
  • The growth strategy ahead
  • The challenges we face
  • The strategic $SLN rebranding
  • And what is in it for YOU.

Interested? Read on.

But first, what are Tapps?

Tapps, or Token As Apps, are tokens with app-like functionality embedded in them. They use every technology we built, are portable, multi-platform, and, more importantly, can be used directly on social platforms.

Tapps is an easier way to understand everything we’ve done so far.

Communities that use Tapps will have a tool to attract attention, grow, and scale in ways that current tokens and incentive mechanics simply cannot.

Which leads us to…

The Use Case: Supercharging Community Growth

Getting and keeping attention is HARD.

Incentive mechanics like Airdrops are burnt out and lead to other problems.

For projects to sustainably attract buyers and grow communities, community-aligned incentive mechanics are needed.

So, while Tapps can do so much more, this is THE problem we’ll focus on.

Enter T-Links

A browser extension that enables crypto users to interact with EVM tokens where they are—their social Feeds.

It’s like Solana Blinks but for every EVM L1 and L2 chain… you can use it with Ethereum, Base, Sui, Monad, and much more.

Adding contextual interactivity means projects can reward actions directly on Twitter, and Holders (or soon-to-be) can earn from their genuine contributions.

It means new features and activations made possible, like:

  1. “Share-to-Earn” mechanics
  2. Lootbox engagement
  3. Voting and Betting Polls
  4. External Dashboards integrated with tokens on user feeds (DexScreener, OpenSea, PumpFun, etc.)
  5. Smart Contract Triggers
  6. Content Unlocks

And much more. It’s honestly limitless in what you can do and a massive booster to value creation.

It creates a direct feedback loop we call the Community Flywheel… More Promotion = More Attention = More Value.

Strategy: The Way Forward

The focus will rest on the (1) Number of Tapps In Use, (2) Total Transactions, and (3) T-Link installations. We want to capture the mainstream narrative, and growing adoption means critical attention from key partnerships, development and listings.

What does this mean exactly?

  1. Promote Tapp Discovery

Development work will go towards releasing live Tapps for T-Link users. Additionally, we have a number of incentives and rewards to deploy. It will be a good time to be an active community member.

2. $SLN Token to be Rebranded (TBA)

We want to signal this shift to the market and clarify what Smart Layer is about. Join our Discord so you don’t miss this one.

3. Mainnet, Staking & Hackathons

Mainnet 2025 continues to be a priority. This will bring out core utility and position us for the next step: Developer programs.

4. Continue Partnership development (TBA)

The Morchi Tapp success attracted attention. Key partnerships will be in store soon.

Tackling Challenges Ahead

To move forward, we acknowledge past challenges.

$SLN Airdrop farmers mean they came and went. Future Tapp discovery and incentives will reward contributions to the ecosystem.

Narrative follows price, and the $SLN chart needs to be worked on. The token will be relaunched to better reflect the focus on Tapps. TBA.

Developer focus will be ramped up with Hackathons and the upcoming release of Mainnet.

KOL support is being considered, though we’re navigating this carefully to avoid predatory deals that ultimately affect the community.

Finally, the market itself: Ethereum mindshare is at its lowest, and there is a heavy focus on the Solana meme-casino and Bitcoin ATH. We recognize this means added effort to bring attention to our mission.

Getting attention is harder than ever…

Tapps & TLinks is a way to capture it, and we intend to showcase it.

Get Involved

  1. Install TLinks here 👉 Web Extension Store
  2. Check out the Guide 👉 Tapps Guide
  3. Join the conversation here 👉 Smart Layer Twitter

And if you’re a Developer, did you know that developing with Tapps can take less than 1 hour?

Chat with us at Tapp Ninjas Discord!

We started Smart Layer to build a tokenized web with true asset ownership for everyone. Tapps will be the way forward for mass adoption and one of the first major crypto consumer apps.

Join us on this mission.

Tapp In.

Tapps: The Way Forward was originally published in Smart Token Labs on Medium, where people are continuing the conversation by highlighting and responding to this story.

item.title: This Week in Tapps #1
item.dc:creator: Sunil Tom Jose
item.content:encoded:
This year in the Web3 domain, we’ve witnessed significant developments reshaping both user interactions and development processes.

One of the most notable innovations is Blinks on Solana, which introduces novel interaction methods. Our team at Smart Token Labs is working to bring similar technology to the EVM domain, with the goal of implementing “run app in place” features. We’re actively developing several components that are enhancing Web3 interactions.

The Tlink web extension elevates social media experiences on platforms like Twitter by transforming Tapp links into interactive UIs.

Additionally, Token-kit is a set of tools designed to accelerate Web3 development, focusing on token-related features. Token-kit/ui, in particular, adopts a Shadcn-like approach for building token-related UIs.

Smart Token Labs is also fostering a Tapp-related developer community and building an SLN TApp Ecosystem. This positions SLN as a value carrier in a closed-loop tokenomic system tailored for developer-facing services.

• STL Introduction Video: A comprehensive overview of Smart Token List (STL) technology and its applications in the Web3 space.

• SLN Documentation: The official documentation for the Smart Linked Node (SLN) project, providing detailed information on its architecture and usage.

Tapps

item.title: Introducing T-Links: Bringing Blinks to EVM Chains
item.dc:creator: Sunil Tom Jose
item.content:encoded:
We’re excited to announce T-Links, the innovative browser plugin that extends support for token apps (tapps) through Token-Links or T-Links, bringing Solana’s Blink like functionality to EVM chains for the first time.

What are T-Links?

T-Links, short for Token Links, is a browser extension that recognises tapp links and renders them as mini-apps directly within the website where the link is shared. Inspired by Solana Blinks by Dialect Labs, T-Links brings similar functionality to EVM chains for the first time.

The Power of T-Links

T-Links represents a significant leap forward in how we interact with blockchain applications.

Embedding actions into token URLs significantly enhance the user experience by allowing token-linked actions to be viewed and initiated from the medium or platform where they are shared. This opens up a whole new world of possibilities for token interaction and utility.

T-Links enable:

  1. Seamless Integration: Users can interact with token applications without leaving their current webpage, reducing friction and complexity.
  2. Increased Accessibility: By bringing Web3 functionality directly into Web2 platforms, Tlinks makes blockchain technology more accessible to mainstream users.
  3. Enhanced Token Utility: Tokens can now have more direct, visible utility across various platforms, potentially increasing their value and adoption.
  4. New Market Opportunities: The ability to share token actions directly within social media platforms creates potential for new markets and new use cases.

Real-World Use Cases

Imagine these scenarios made possible by Tlinks:

  • Clicking on a concert ticket NFT shared on Twitter and being able to transfer or sell it directly from the tweet.
  • Viewing a rare collectible item in a forum post and immediately making an offer to purchase it.
  • Participating in a DAO vote directly from a forum message containing the proposal link.
  • Swapping tokens or providing liquidity in a DeFi protocol straight from a news article discussing the project.

Installation Guide

To get started with T-Links:

  1. Go to T-Link Chrome Extension
  2. Add extension to your browser
  3. Enable Metamask support in the extension settings

Creating and Sharing T-Links

Generating a T-Link is straightforward:

  1. Visit the Smart Token Viewer
  2. Locate your token and open any action
  3. Copy the generated link

This link, when viewed on a browser with T-Links plugin activated, it will render as a mini-app, allowing for immediate interaction based on the token’s TokenScript file.

Future Developments

While T-Links is in its early stages of development, the roadmap is promising. As progress continues on the upcoming tapp framework, users can expect additional features that will further enhance the T-Links experience.

As the very next step, T-Links would extend support for more wallets starting with Rabby wallet.

By bringing token actions directly into the platforms where discussions and sharing occur, T-Links reduces friction and increases engagement with tokens.

This technology has the potential to:

  • Enhance NFT utility and visibility
  • Facilitate easier onboarding for new users into the Web3 space
  • Create new opportunities for token-gated content and experiences
  • Streamline DeFi interactions

T-Link support is the latest addition to the Smart Layer’s tapp tool-kit, that will provide the best token based experiences on Web3.

We encourage the community to try out T-Links and share their feedback. Your insights will be invaluable in shaping the future of this exciting technology.

Together, let’s bridge the gap between Web2 and Web3!

item.title: DegDegen Distillery x Smart Layer: onboarding normies to web3
item.dc:creator: Sunil Tom Jose
item.content:encoded:
Smart Layer x Degen Distillery: Onboarding Normies to Web3

What is it — Overview

Degen Distillery is a pioneering spirits brand that merges the traditional alcohol industry with modern blockchain technology. Co-created by a community of artists, innovators, and disruptors, it aims to revolutionize how spirits are produced, marketed, and sold. The brand is built on a unique model called “social distribution,” which decentralizes its salesforce and allows community members to tokenize their contributions, effectively owning a share of the revenue they generate. Key partnerships with industry giants like BrewDog and Google bolster its innovative approach and market reach.

What is $DRINK

The $DRINK token is the native cryptocurrency of Degen Distillery, serving as the backbone of its community. Designed to unlock a variety of benefits, the token facilitates participation in digital experiences, physical venues, and partner events. It is integral to the brand’s growth strategy and is expected to offer unique utilities that enhance community engagement and reward contributors.

What is Unique About It and How You Can Earn with It

The $DRINK token stands out due to its multifaceted utility and the innovative Tokenized Affiliate Protocol (TAP). This protocol allows contributors to tokenize their efforts, ensuring they receive financial benefits from the value they create. Unlike traditional affiliate programs that may offer fluctuating cryptocurrency rewards, Degen Distillery secures the value generated through NFTs, providing a stable and tangible return on investment.

You can earn with the $DRINK token by:

  • Participating in the Community: Engage in community-led projects, contribute creative ideas, or help in marketing and distribution.
  • Referral Bonuses: Create referral codes to earn bonuses in $DRINK for contributions made through your links.
  • NFT Ownership: Hold NFTs tied to your contributions, which can generate revenue streams based on the success of the products you help promote.

What are the Relevant Metrics

As of now, Degen Distillery is in the early stages of its launch, with specific metrics still developing. However, some relevant figures include:

  • Community Engagement: The brand is actively building its community, with a growing presence on platforms like Discord, where members can collaborate and share ideas.
  • Market Cap: The current market cap for $DRINK is not yet established, as the token is in its initial rollout phase.
  • User Base: The brand aims to attract a large community of creators and consumers, leveraging its partnerships to reach a broader audience.

What are the Partnerships

Degen Distillery has secured significant partnerships that enhance its operational capabilities and market reach:

  • BrewDog: This partnership allows Degen Distillery to utilize BrewDog’s extensive production and distribution network, which includes over 120 venues worldwide. BrewDog also provides marketing support and access to a large customer base.
  • Google: Selected for Google’s Web3 startup program, Degen Distillery benefits from technical support, funding, and Google Cloud credits. This partnership positions the brand within a robust network of leading Web3 businesses, enhancing its growth potential.

Together, these partnerships not only provide logistical and technical support but also align Degen Distillery with established brands that share its vision of innovation and community engagement.

item.title: Hi all,
item.dc:creator: Luke Toledo
item.content:encoded:
Hi all,

I’m writing to update you, the community, on $SLN and Smart Layer progress in the 6 months since our February TGE and to outline our strategy for the year ahead.

To start with, I would like to address the token price and the de-listing by OKX.

We are obviously very disappointed.

OKX listing us but restricting $SLN from trading in most major crypto markets had a significant impact on price trajectory.

The inability to build market support for the token has seen us underperform the market and other altcoins.

Despite a steady stream of very positive developments around ecosystem growth, tech adoption, and flagship partnerships, we have been unable to bring in new investors because the token was simply too hard to acquire on our most public exchange partner.

The delisting has contributed to the under-performance relative to the altcoin market.

But it is not the only factor.

We have to do better on the narrative and communication of our technology USP, and that is addressed in some detail below.

Time To Rebuild

We are now focused ahead on rebuilding. There is no shortcut to this process, but we are fully committed to it.

There are 4 primary drivers for reclaiming a +$200m FDV Market Cap over the next 12 months, and these are:

  • Ecosystem and technology adoption
  • Cut through for our tApps narrative
  • Listing on Binance and Bithumb
  • Crypto macro turning bullish for altcoins

Ecosystem And Technology Adoption

In the past 6 months, we have achieved very significant and accelerated growth in the building out of our ecosystem and the adoption of Smart Layer tech by flagship partners.

Partner projects using ERC-5169 + TokenScript to create tApps ( Tokens as Apps ) include the following:

  • Redbrick Land, a major web2 game developer in South Korea with millions of players, has used Smart Layer tech to launch 10k game achievement tokens → here.
  • Klaytn Foundation, a major South Korean blockchain (to be renamed Kaia), launched 7 Dragons using Smart Layer tech with 77k tokens as passports to their ecosystem → here.
  • Mint Blockchain, an NFT-focused blockchain targeting Asian NFT creators, has created a smart token collection of 50k Mint Cats using Smart Layer tech → here.
  • Baby Shark Universe global IP is coming to Smart Layer in a game + experience universe connected via an unlimited PFP collection powered by Smart Layer → here.
  • MOOAR NFT Marketplace has fully integrated TokenScript and is introducing native gameplay to an NFT marketplace for the first time with Smart Layer → here.
  • Degen Distillery is bringing RWA to the alcohol industry in partnership with Brew Dog and has partnered with Smart Layer to onboard web2 users at scale to $DRINK.
  • SEI Blockchain has agreed to a partnership that will launch in September to bring mini-games to SEI using smart layer tech and launchpad
  • Polygon Games and NFT have agreed on a partnership to launch a series of mini-games that can be played on Telegram, Discord and Farcaster using Smart Layer tech.

All of the above projects and partnerships involve Smart Layer receiving grants or payments via tokens or cash for development work or to launch the project via Launchpad, securing a growing stream of revenue to fund Smart Layer operations.

In addition to these partnerships, we have dramatically expanded our ecosystem through over a dozen wallet integrations and other points of distribution or integration.

You can see our full Ecosystem Map here.

Our network growth continues to accelerate. Since the TGE in February, we have recorded:

  • 27.8m network connections ✅
  • 305.7k wallets connected ✅
  • 137k tokens issued ✅

New Narrative… tApps (Tokens as Apps)

Narrative has been an Achilles heel for Smart Layer, and we have found it consistently difficult to meet the prevailing market meta.

Our new narrative is based on tApps > Tokens as Apps as a solution to the crypto problem of too few consumer apps. tApps are a new type of token that incorporates app-like utility. They are a category-shaping solution for Crypto.

Tokens to date have mainly focused on ownership without being interactive.

Solana’s Blinks and the EVM’s OKContract bring interactions to dApps, allowing users to interact with smart contracts and transact directly on a webpage (e.g. stake, buy, sell, or transfer by simply clicking a button).

tApps unlock app-like functionality within tokens themselves. They unlock the full gamut of read, write, and own by enabling tokens to carry frontends and become experiences. tApps can be distributed in any channel: wallets, websites, social media, marketplaces, and platforms.

All of the partnerships we have launched in the past 6 months demonstrate the power of tApps as a category-shaping solution for Crypto.

Hear the heads of strategy for MOOAR (the team behind STEPN and Gas Heroes), Polygon and Smart Layer discuss the tApp we are building together and what this means for the future of NFTS and Gaming when tokens adopt app-like utility.

Listing $SLN On Binance And Bithumb

There is no shortcut to getting listed on the key exchanges we want to be listed on.

Nevertheless, we remain committed to building confidence with Binance and Bithumb in our team, our vision, and the progress we are making on a category-shaping solution for Crypto.

We have never been further advanced in our technology and product-market fit. Over the coming 12 months, we will ensure our progress and ability to deliver are understood despite the setbacks we have encountered in the past few months.

Listing on Binance and Bithumb are not outcomes we can control, but we will do everything in our power to deliver this result in time to capture the full impact of the bull run.

We remain listed on 10 global exchanges, including KuCoin, Gate.io and Crypto.com.

Crypto Macro Turning Bullish For Altcoins

We share our investors' frustration as we approach what may be a historic bull run. But we do believe there is the time and, most importantly, the product momentum to turn this around and ensure material value capture through $SLN.

If you want to know what you can do to help us over the coming weeks, there are 3 things we would welcome your support on:

  • Talk about tApps, the projects and the tech we are delivering
  • Help us find 3rd parties to talk about tApps, the projects and the tech we are delivering
  • Connect us with partners who want to build tApps

All the best,
Victor

item.title: 从用户角度看Web3/Crypto：Token为中心的新世界
item.dc:creator: Victor Zhang
item.content:encoded:
在Web3和加密货币的世界里，对用户而言，一切都可以归结为Token和围绕Token的应用。这个新兴的生态系统彻底改变了我们与数字世界的互动方式。让我们来探讨这个以Token为中心的新世界。

  1. Token：Web3/Crypto的核心

对于用户来说，Web3/Crypto的所有内容都可以被视为Token或围绕Token的应用。Token不仅仅是加密货币，它可以代表任何形式的数字价值或权益。Token可以是可替代的（如大多数加密货币），也可以是非同质化的（如NFT）；可以是可转让的，也可以是不可转让的（如某些身份凭证）。理解Token的多样性是理解Web3世界的关键。

2. Token生态系统的四大支柱

Web3/Crypto生态系统主要围绕着以下四个方面展开：

a) Token的创建，Token的创建可以分为两大类：

1. 去中心化 + 去中介化：

区块链原生加密货币及其衍生品：这类Token是通过一群用户参与PoW、PoS等共识机制共同创建的。例如比特币、以太坊等。

用户个人创建的Token，社交Token，身份Token，内容Token等

2. 中心化 + 去中介化：

实体经济的产品和服务提供商创建的Token

这类Token虽然由中心化的实体创建，但在流通过程中不需要传统的中介和平台

b) Token的分发：

Token的分发涉及如何将Token免费或付费地送到用户手里。这包括多种方式：

– 空投：免费向特定用户群发放Token

– 挖矿：通过参与网络维护获得Token奖励

– ICO（首次代币发行）：用户通过投资获得新项目的Token

– 质押：用户锁定资产以获得Token奖励

– 任务奖励：完成特定任务获得Token

c) Token的流通：

Token的流通围绕着所有权变化的各种玩法，主要表现为Token验证后智能合约状态的变化：

– 交易：在交易所/市场进行Token交换，智能合约自动执行Token转移

– 借贷：在DeFi平台上，用户提供或借入Token，智能合约管理借贷关系

– 质押：用户将Token锁定在智能合约中以获得收益或参与网络治理

– 流动性提供：用户将Token对提供给自动做市商(AMM)，智能合约管理流动性池

d) Token的使用：

Token的使用通常不改变所有权，更倾向于连接实体经济。这经常表现为Token验证后中心化数据库状态的变化：

– 访问服务：使用Token解锁特定内容或服务，服务提供商的数据库更新用户权限

– 治理参与：在DAO中使用Token进行投票，投票结果记录在中心化数据库中

– 身份验证：使用Token证明身份或资格，验证结果更新到相关系统的数据库

– 实物商品购买：使用Token购买商品，商家系统更新库存和订单状态

3. 验证：Web3和Web2的根本区别

验证方式是Web3和Web2在本质上的核心区别：

  • Web2验证：由大平台、中介、大厂或创建方完成，他们是把关人（Gate Keeper）
  • - Web3验证：用户自证，每个用户都是自己的把关人

这种差异带来了深远的影响：

  • Web3实现了”用户自证”，带来开放性、自由竞争和无限可能
  • - Web2无法实现这种程度的用户自主权

4. Web3的优势与挑战

优势：

  • 开放性和自由竞争：任何人都可以参与创新和价值创造
  • - 用户对数据和资产的完全控制：用户真正拥有并管理自己的数字资产
  • - 无需信任的交互：通过密码学和智能合约实现可信的交易和协作

挑战：

  • 性能问题：这是目前最主要的技术挑战，影响了可扩展性
  • - 用户体验：管理私钥、理解复杂概念对普通用户来说仍有难度
  • - 监管不确定性：全球各地的监管态度不一，可能影响采用

Web3的不足，除了性能以外，其他的部分都能补得上。而Web2无法实现”用户自证”带来的开放，自由竞争和其带来的无限可能。

结语：

从用户的角度来看，Web3/Crypto世界是一个以Token为中心的新生态系统。它通过革命性的验证机制，重新定义了价值的创造、分发、流通和使用。Token的创建不再局限于少数实体，而是开放给所有用户，无论是通过参与共识机制还是作为个人创造者。

虽然仍面临一些挑战，特别是性能问题，但Web3带来的开放性、自由竞争和无限可能性，正在彻底改变我们与数字世界的互动方式。其他的挑战，如用户体验和监管问题，在很大程度上是可以解决的。

作为用户，理解这个以Token为核心的新范式至关重要。它不仅赋予我们更大的自主权，也为我们提供了参与和塑造这个新兴数字经济的机会。在这个去中心化、去中介化的世界里，每个用户都可能成为创新者、价值创造者和自己数据的主人。

Web3的”用户自证”机制带来的开放性和自由竞争，为我们创造了一个充满无限可能的新世界。尽管道路可能还很长，但这个以Token为中心的新世界已经开始塑造我们的数字未来。作为用户，我们不仅是这场变革的见证者，更是积极的参与者和塑造者。拥抱这个Token驱动的新世界，探索其中的无限可能，也许就是我们迈向真正数字自由的第一步。​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

item.title: The TokenScript Framework: unlocking a new frontier in tokens as a digital primitive
item.dc:creator: Luke Toledo
item.content:encoded:
The TokenScript Framework provides a pathway for web3 developers and entrepreneurs to unlock the next frontier in tokens as a digital primitive.

Much like the evolution of previous digital primitives such as websites and mobile apps, tokens are set to explode in both utility and application as they become far more advanced. The exact nature of these advanced applications is not yet fully understood, but it is likely to herald innovation and disruption akin to websites evolving from brochureware to ecommerce. Or mobile apps evolving from simple games to on-demand marketplaces for just about everything.

The TokenScript Framework is one of the approaches to upgrading tokens to “mobile app-like” interactive objects, pushing tokens beyond their traditional limits. It integrates a trustless, verifiable user interface (UI) directly into the token and securely links this UI to the token via ERC-5169.

The TokenScript Framework comprises four core components: Smart Layer Network, Smart Token, Smart Token Viewer and Smart Token Explorer. The main architecture is below:

Let’s explain it in plain English:

  1. The Smart Layer Network comprises a set of nodes named “smart layer network service node” that support the running of smart tokens.
  2. A smart token has a token-specific frontend which is also verifiable.
    • A verifiable token frontend makes the whole app trustless; unlike current dapps, users must trust the dapp providers.
  3. Smart Token Viewer is a secure sandbox for verifying and running smart tokens.
    • It is loaded from the network, and its update asks for the voting of all the nodes in the network.
    • It can be embedded or standalone.
  4. Smart Token Explorer is an official site for users’ smart token management.
    • Like Smart Viewer, it is also hosted by nodes in the network.
    • Its domain is backed by the domain enhanced by Web3 Technology.

Smart Token

Conceptionally, a smart token can be seen as the following:

One smart token is a verifiable mini-app with more:

  • Portable, it can run on any dapps or wallets embedding smart viewer.
  • Composable smart tokens can work together to solve complex workflow.
  • Addressable, each token has a URI for access.

At the same time, it is self-described:

  • Source token frontend
    - Signature
    - Last updated
  • Spec of token behaviour
    - Methods
    - Messaging

Smart Token Explorer

Smart Token Explorer can be seen as a user’s smart token wallet:

  • Its domain is a web3-enabled domain.
  • Its source code is loaded from a decentralised network and can not be updated randomly.

For loading smart tokens

  • It will load all smart tokens owned by users in the registry contract automatically.
  • Else, a user can add them manually.

It looks like the following:

Smart Token Viewer

Smart Token Viewer is a secure sandbox for running a smart token.

  • 1 smart token must be running in a viewer.
  • To the viewer, the smart token is similar to a Cloudflare worker in the container.
  • All external handlers are injected by the viewer, some candidates:
    - eth provider, http client, storage …
  • The communication between tokens is built on top of the channel.

It is also the controller of smart tokens

  • Verify its correctness.
  • Update the code

Like Smart Token Explorer, it is also loaded from a decentralised network. Other features include:

  • It can be embedded in a dapp or wallet
  • It can be running as a standalone app with either of the following
    - A smart token URI
    - Clicking a smart token in Smart Token Explorer
  • It is a plugin system which can be extended by Smart Action.

A smart action can be seen as an extension of a smart token viewer. Its features and behaviours are TBD, so we will ignore the details in this article.

Smart Layer Network

In this decentralised network, nodes named “smart layer network service nodes” are running. For each node:

  • It is a peer in the decentralised network.
  • Hosting the key component’s source code
    - Smart Token Explorer & Smart Viewer
  • It will save the runtime data in the network
    - Registry: SLN peer and smart action
    - Peer data for monitoring and reputation checking
  • Finally, it is “autononymous”:
    - Permissionless
    - Governance
    - Voting-based source code updating

Roadmap

Split into milestones. You can see more details in the Roadmap.

Conclusion

The TokenScript Framework will unlock the next frontier in tokens as a digital primitive.

Leveraging the power of the Smart Layer Network, verifiable smart tokens, secure sandbox environments, and decentralized management tools, this framework addresses many of the trust and security issues that are plaguing the blockchain space.

As this technology continues to develop, it promises a more secure, efficient, and user-friendly approach to managing digital assets and interacting with the web.

The next wave of tokens as a digital primitive is almost upon us and the TokenScript Framework is set to lead the way.

item.title: You can now monetize your gameplay
item.dc:creator: Luke Toledo
item.content:encoded:
Web3 gaming just got a lot more rewarding: using Account Tokens, your playtime and in-game achievements can be stored within a tradable token that can be bought and sold on on-chain exchanges and marketplaces.

It’s a new meta for Web3 gaming. As a player, you can now create value through play in different ways and benefit from every unique experience and achievement you conquer.

Gaming should be about fun, and this puts the focus back in play, not just pay-to-win mechanics. Smart Layer is providing the technology to enable this in Web3 gaming.

How It Works

Account Tokens use ERC-5169 and TokenScript technology to track and store user action and data, both on-chain and off-chain.

Your Account Token “levels up” with achievements, badges, and XP as you play, increasing its value. Achievements and playtime are token-bound, meaning they carry over when traded or transferred.

You can then trade these tokens in NFT marketplaces in decentralized exchanges (when ST404 is enabled).

Use Cases

Smart Cats

Smart Cats allowed players to level up their Cat xNFTs through actions like cleaning, feeding, and play dates. Holding the NFT gave better access to airdrop and trade value. This initiative attracted over 270,000+ players and saw over 20 million transactions.

Redbrick Land

Redbrick Land launched 10,000 Brc:ID NFTs using Account Tokens, with all player achievements being token-bound and tradable. Players in the ecosystem can accumulate points, XP, in-game achievements, associate land, and much more with it.

Seven Dragons Collection

The upcoming Seven Dragons Collection by Knightfury404 and Klaytn Official will feature playable tokens that users can level up to access rewards on the South Korean-based Kaia blockchain.

The Future of Web3 Gaming

The tokenization of accounts and achievements allows players to benefit from their gameplay, participation, and skills in new and exciting ways.

This mechanic benefits platforms, games, and more. Ecosystem play can unlock new gaming opportunities; gameplay can unlock more control of balancing direction and items. Even outside of gaming… for example, if used with DeFi, unlock tradable benefits when creating larger LPs or trading higher volumes.

Any action can be gamified and tradable to the full benefit of the participant. Web3 Gaming and the Ethereum Summer are just around the corner. Are you excited yet?
